newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Leer expects full year net growth.
newsitem.headline: Van Leer expects full year net growth.

text.p: Dutch packaging group Van Leer said on Tuesday it expected full year net profit growth to match that of the first half.

"Barring unforeseen circumstances management expects that net profit over the full year 1996 will show an improvement in line with the improvement of the first half year," the company said in a statement with first half results.

The company, which was floated on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange last May, previously said it expected further earnings growth in 1996. In 1995 full-year net profit rose by 17 percent to 79.4 million guilders.
Van Leer earlier reported a 23 percent rise in first half net profit to 47 million guilders with operating profit before interest and tax rising 11 percent to 105.1 million guilders.

"An important driver for the increased operational earnings is the improved profitability of the consumer packaging business. Especially the moulded fibre business in the USA, pusheed by higher sales turned in very satisfactory results," Van Leer said.
